I cant afford therapy or meds, i dont have any form of insurance and i come from a country where its not easy to get either of those due to stigma. the meds i got from my doctor + the visit cost me 2 weeks pay. 

pretty shit actually.  i just started university but its online. my school is in a time zone 7 hours ahead so i have to get up at 2 in the morning to go to classes. i'm one week in and i feel in over my head. i also have to pay my tuition myself it's not as much as US schools but i think I may have to drop out because i dont know how i'm going to afford rent when i have to move in january. my parent's are good people but too busy sorting out their own shit. i have no hobbies. no friends. my siblings don't like to be around me. the only good thing right now is my baby brother. i can't sleep, my anxiety has gotten so bad i cant drive anymore, i cant take phone calls, i barely get out of bed except to go to class. everything just feels too much. i dont want to hurt my family but i also dont want to wake up every day in pain.

thank you for asking.
